svg.metadata: Ferrosift retrofit module M01-W1; model-derived HLR and solid sections; geometry mm; A3 landscape; Retrofit sensing module / general arrangement
svg.text: The module is the proposed product. The existing recycling line is host context only.
PLAN / module only, existing belt omitted / 1:25
Sensor head, optical hardware, two-direction electromagnetic research
cartridges, mounting adapters, encoder association, acquisition/control
Host belt, supporting deck, frame and roller references are not part of the
proposed product. Integration is conditional on host compatibility.
Only a central 180 mm lane is constrained. The outer host lanes are unused.
Neither nominal lane width nor modeled coil size establishes useful sensing
X follows travel, Y is across the belt, Z is up. All positions are proposed
coordination dimensions, not approved installation dimensions.
The CAD demonstrates a packaging hypothesis. Test magnetic background,
dynamic association, classifier value, cleaning, safety and maintainability
DIMENSIONS: mm | SCALE PER VIEW AT A3 | PROPOSED RESEARCH GEOMETRY
No approved fit, tolerance, load, electromagnetic coverage, throughput or safeguarding rating.
